result.topic_en: Definition of a 'productive' system of modules (no module divides the least common multiple of the others), with a construction of a number δ not divisible by any of the modules, followed by scratch calculations with greatest common divisors and least common multiples of modules.
result.transcription:
Ein System von Moduln $\mathfrak{a}_1, \mathfrak{a}_2 \ldots \mathfrak{a}_n$ heisst productiv,
wenn keines von ihnen ein Theiler des kleinsten gemeinsamen Viel-
fachen aller übrigen ist.
Es sei [-$\mathfrak{a}_r$-] $\mathfrak{b}_r$ das kleinste gemeinsame Vielfache der $(n-1)$
Moduln $\mathfrak{a}_s$, wo $s$ verschieden von $r$; es sei ferner $\mathfrak{m}$ das
kleinste gemeinsame Vielfache aller $n$ Moduln $\mathfrak{a}_r$, also
$\mathfrak{m} = \mathfrak{a}_r - \mathfrak{b}_r$.
$\mathfrak{a}_r$ kein Theiler von $\mathfrak{b}_r$; $\mathfrak{b}_r$ echter Theiler von $\mathfrak{m}$.
Man kann daher aus jedem $\mathfrak{b}_r$ eine Zahl $\beta_r$ entnehmen,
die nicht [-also-] in $\mathfrak{m}$ enthalten ist. Setzt man
$\delta = \beta_1 + \beta_2 + \cdots + \beta_n = \Sigma\beta_r$,
so ist
[-$\mathfrak{A}$-] $\delta \equiv \beta_r \pmod{\mathfrak{a}_r}$,
also $\delta$ durch keinen Modul $\mathfrak{a}_r$ theilbar.
$\delta \equiv 0 \pmod{\mathfrak{b}_1 + \mathfrak{b}_2 + \mathfrak{b}_3 + \cdots + \mathfrak{b}_n}$
Setzt man
$\mathfrak{t}_r = \mathfrak{b}_1 + \mathfrak{b}_2 + \cdots + \mathfrak{b}_{r-1} + \mathfrak{b}_{r+1} + \cdots + \mathfrak{b}_n = \overset{s}{\Sigma}\mathfrak{b}_s$
so ist
$\mathfrak{t}_r > \mathfrak{a}_r$
$\alpha$ enthalten in [-$\mathfrak{a} \mathfrak{t}_1 \pm \mathfrak{m}_3$; $\mathfrak{a} \Sigma \mathfrak{b}_s$-]
$\mathfrak{a} - (\mathfrak{b} + \mathfrak{t}_1) = \mathfrak{a} - \mathfrak{b}'' = \mathfrak{a}_1$ ; $\mathfrak{n} = [\alpha] > \mathfrak{a}_1$
$= \mathfrak{a} - (\mathfrak{b} + \mathfrak{t}) = \mathfrak{a} - \mathfrak{a}''$
$\mathfrak{b} + \mathfrak{t}_1 = $ [-$\mathfrak{A}$-] $\mathfrak{b}''$
$\mathfrak{a} - \mathfrak{b}'' = \mathfrak{a}_1$
$(\mathfrak{a}_1, \mathfrak{t}_3) = (\mathfrak{a}_1, \mathfrak{a}_2)(\mathfrak{a}_2, \mathfrak{t}_3) = \mathfrak{d}\mathfrak{b}_1$
$(\mathfrak{t}, \mathfrak{b}) = \mathfrak{c}'\mathfrak{d}\mathfrak{b}_1 = (\mathfrak{t}, \mathfrak{a}_3)$
$\mathfrak{t} < \mathfrak{t}_1 < \mathfrak{t}_2 < \mathfrak{a}_3$, $\mathfrak{b}_3 < \mathfrak{d}_4$
$\mathfrak{t}_1 = \mathfrak{c}'\mathfrak{t}$ ; $\mathfrak{t}_2 = \mathfrak{d}\mathfrak{t}_1$ ; $\mathfrak{a}_3 = \mathfrak{b}_1\mathfrak{t}_2$ ; $\mathfrak{b}_3 = \mathfrak{a}_1\mathfrak{t}_2$ ; $\mathfrak{d}_4 = \mathfrak{a}_1\mathfrak{a}_3 = \mathfrak{b}_1\mathfrak{b}_3$.

methods.what: Definition of a productive system of modules: no module divides the lcm of the others
methods.quote:
Ein System von Moduln $\mathfrak{a}_1, \mathfrak{a}_2 \ldots \mathfrak{a}_n$ heisst productiv,
wenn keines von ihnen ein Theiler des kleinsten gemeinsamen Viel-

methods.what: lcm of all modules equals intersection of a_r with lcm b_r of the others
Construction of a number δ as sum of elements β_r of b_r not in m, so δ ≡ β_r mod a_r and δ is divisible by no a_r
δ lies in the sum of the modules b_r
Sum t_r of all b_s with s≠r is a proper divisor of a_r
Scratch relations among gcds/lcms of modules

items.quote: $\mathfrak{a}_r$ kein Theiler von $\mathfrak{b}_r$; $\mathfrak{b}_r$ echter Theiler von $\mathfrak{m}$.

t_r > a_r (t_r is a proper divisor of a_r).
